working_definition: Author type 'LC10d' of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas (Supplementary Table 1).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Subtype of lobula columnar neuron LC10B. It has its main arbors in lobula layers 4 to 6, with less dense arbors in 5B than in layers 4, 6 or 5A (in contrast to LC10a). Presynaptic sites are observed in layers 4 and 6 (less numerous than LC10a in layer 3 and LC10b in layer 6). Its arbor is much smaller than LC10b. There are around 84 cells of this type.

justification: 'LC10d' is the exact label or an exact synonym of FBbt:00111748 'lobula columnar neuron LC10d'.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00111748 'lobula columnar neuron LC10d' (exact match).
